next.reason: 1985: file-name-1 in a USE statement 'must not cause the simultaneous request for execution of more than one USE procedure'. 1985 itself already let a file-name USE coexist with an open-mode USE (§1985:IX.4.8.4 GR4 'When file-name-1 is specified explicitly, no other USE statement applies to file-name-1'), so the rule refuses only a file-name named in two USE statements. 2023 keeps that refusal, §2023:14.9.49.3 SR8 'The same file-name shall not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement within the same procedure division', and keeps one procedure per event: §2023:14.9.49.4 GR5 (a file-name USE 'takes precedence over any USE statements specifying an INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O, or EXTEND phrase') and §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3 ('no other declaratives are executed'). Same programs refused, same procedure run.
